query:
SELECT 
  pi.*,
  po.supplierId,
  p.name as supplier_name,
  po.totalAmount as purchase_total
FROM purchaseInstallments pi
LEFT JOIN purchaseOrders po ON po.id = pi.purchaseOrderId
LEFT JOIN partners p ON p.id = po.supplierId
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING';
